description: Real bean-leaf CNN vs MobileNet benchmark, calibrated probabilities, Grad-CAM and strict local API

issues.title: Validate on farm-disjoint external field photos
issues.body: Plant/farm identifiers are unavailable in the current supplied split. Collect independently licensed, farm-disjoint field images and evaluate the frozen model before claiming deployment generalization.

issues.title: Evaluate unknown-class abstention
issues.body: The current softmax classifier has only three labels and cannot reliably reject other crops or diseases. Add an independently evaluated unknown-class set, select abstention on validation and report coverage versus risk.
